header.running_head: Relationships between Men, Women and Children

blocks.text: while the Sahabah (RA) were sitting by his door. When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) arrived and sought permission to enter, Rasulullaah ﷺ did not grant him permission. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then arrived and Rasulullaah ﷺ did not grant him permission to enter either. Rasulullaah ﷺ later granted permission to both Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) and they both entered the room where Rasulullaah ﷺ was sitting in silence with his wives around him. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to himself, "I am going to say something to make Rasulullaah ﷺ laugh." He then proceeded to say, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! If only you had seen (my wife) the daughter of Zaid just now when I slapped her across the neck when she asked me for (an increase in her) allowance!" Rasulullaah ﷺ smiled so broadly that his molars became visible. He said, "Here are my wives around me also asking me for (an increase in) their allowances."

Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then stood up to hit (his daughter) Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) also got up to hit (his daughter) Hadhrat Hafsah (RA). Both men were rebuking their daughters saying, "How can you ask Rasulullaah ﷺ for something he does not have?!" Rasulullaah ﷺ however stopped the two men and the women said, "By Allaah! After this, we shall never again ask Rasulullaah ﷺ for something he does not have."

It was on this occasion that Allaah revealed the verse offering a choice (to Rasulullaah ﷺ's wives). Rasulullaah ﷺ first approached Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) saying, "I am about to present to you an offer that I do not want you to be hasty in deciding until you have consulted with your parents." "What is it?" she asked. Rasulullaah ﷺ then recited for her the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِّأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا ۝ وَإِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنْكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
blocks.text: O Nabi ﷺ! Say to your wives, "If you desire the life of this world and its adornments, then come forward. I shall grant you a generous provision and separate from you (divorce you) in a cordial manner. However, if you desire Allaah, His Rasool ﷺ and the home of the Aakhirah, then (you may continue enjoying the status of being his wives and living with the allowance he provides because) Allaah has certainly prepared a grand reward for those of you who do good deeds (Allaah will reward you tremendously for your sacrifice)."

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) immediately said, "Should I consult my parents about (having) you?! I definitely choose Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ. Please do not inform any of your other wives what I have decided." Rasulullaah ﷺ told her, "Allaah has sent me to make matters easy for people and not to make them difficult.
